description: This file defines an abstract class EnvBuildVersionGenerator and several concrete subclasses for different CI environments, used to generate version information based on environment variables.

classes.name: EnvBuildVersionGenerator
classes.description: An abstract class that generates version codes and names based on environment variables, with subclasses for specific CI environments.

classes.name: EnvBuildVersionGenerator.CircleCi
classes.description: A subclass for CircleCI environment, using the CIRCLE_BUILD_NUM environment variable.

classes.name: EnvBuildVersionGenerator.Shippable
classes.description: A subclass for Shippable CI environment, using the BUILD_NUMBER environment variable.

classes.name: EnvBuildVersionGenerator.Generic
classes.description: A generic subclass for custom environment variables to generate version info.

methods.name: isValidForEnvironment
methods.description: Checks if the required environment variable is set and not blank.

methods.name: getVersionCode
methods.description: Returns the version code by parsing the environment variable and adding an offset.

methods.name: getVersionName
methods.description: Returns the version name based on the generation data, applying a patch offset.
